assets.headline: Calm browsing by default.
assets.caption: Blur web media until you reveal it.

assets.headline: Media arrives quiet.
assets.caption: Images, video, canvases, and eligible background images are blurred and dimmed in place — never removed.

assets.headline: Reveal one thing, on your own gesture.
assets.caption: Click, hover, hover with click-to-lock, or hold the peek shortcut. Everything else on the page stays quiet.

assets.headline: The popup leads with what is actually happening.
assets.caption: Effective state first: this page, the rule it follows, and which rule it inherits from.

assets.headline: Per-site rules, filed and editable.
assets.caption: Global default, per-domain overrides, blur strength, reveal mode, and emoji presentation. Settings and overrides stay in browser-local storage.

assets.headline: Pause is stated, not implied.
assets.caption: Paused everywhere is stamped on the record, and every control stays usable while it is paused.
